resources.string: No nap was recorded for this day.
This nap has no stage scoring from its source, so no stages are shown.
This nap is no longer in your data. It may have been replaced by a newer sync.
A nap is any sleep that is not your main sleep. Start, end and minutes are shown as your source reported them, with the source named under each figure.
A figure the source did not report is left blank. Apex does not work it out from other numbers.
